era: 1893 年生于江苏苏州一个书香世家——'江南第一读书人家'，祖父为金石学者；1913 年入北京大学预科，1916 年入中国哲学门，1920 年毕业留校任图书馆编目员——在北大期间受胡适《中国哲学史大纲》与钱玄同疑古思想的双重激发；1922 年为商务印书馆编纂《中学本国史教科书》时发现尧舜禹的先后地位与传说时代矛盾——层累说的直接触机；1923 年在《读书杂志》发表《与钱玄同先生论古史书》提出'层累地造成的中国古史'说，引发刘掞藜、胡堇人应战与持续近二十年的古史大论战；1924 年发表《孟姜女故事的研究》把层累方法移植到民俗学；1926 年《古史辨》第一册出版，后陆续出至第七册；1927 年赴中山大学，1929 年执教燕京大学；1934 年创办禹贡学会与《禹贡》半月刊，培养谭其骧、侯仁之、史念海等，历史地理学由此发端；抗战期间辗转西北、西南，主持边疆研究与《尚书》研究；1949 年后历任中国科学院历史研究所研究员，主持《尚书》整理与《资治通鉴》标点工作；1980 年 12 月病逝于北京——一生日记近七百万字，《古史辨》九册（含《古史辨自序》）成为中国现代史学奠基文献之一
era_en: Born 1893 in Suzhou, Jiangsu, into a scholarly house called 'the first reading family of Jiangnan', his grandfather a student of bronzes and inscriptions; entering Peking University's preparatory school in 1913 and the school of Chinese philosophy in 1916, graduating in 1920 to catalogue the university library — doubly kindled in those years by Hu Shih's Outline of the History of Chinese Philosophy and Qian Xuantong's doubting of antiquity; in 1922, editing a school history for the Commercial Press, he found the sequence of Yao, Shun and Yu at odds with the ages of their legends — the direct spark of the cumulative thesis; in 1923 his Letter to Mr. Qian Xuanton on Ancient History in the Reading Magazine set out 'the ancient history of China cumulatively fabricated', drawing the replies of Liu Ku-e-li and Hu Jin-ren and a great debate on ancient history that ran nearly twenty years; in 1924 his Study of the Legend of Meng Jiangnü carried the method into folklore; in 1926 the first volume of the Gushibian appeared, in time seven; to Sun Yat-sen University in 1927, to Yenching in 1929; in 1934 he founded the Yu Gong Society and its fortnightly, training Tan Qixiang, Hou Renzhi and Shi Nianhai — historical geography began there; through the war he moved across the northwest and southwest, directing frontier studies and the study of the Book of Documents; after 1949 research professor at the Institute of History of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, directing the collation of the Documents and the punctuation of the Comprehensive Mirror; he died in Beijing in December 1980 — a diary of nearly seven million characters, and the Gushibian, with its great preface, among the founding documents of modern Chinese historiography
school: 古史辨派 / 层累造史说 / 民俗学运动 / 历史地理学奠基 / 现代学术资料工程
historical_significance: 中国现代史学'疑古学派'的立法者：《古史辨》九册与'层累地造成的中国古史'说把两千年信古传统逼进了必须自我辩护的境地——胡适称之为'今日史学界的一大贡献'，傅斯年虽不同意亦承认其震动之功；他把辨伪从'黜伪存真'升级为'不立一真，惟穷流变'——研究客体从上古真相置换为古史观念的演变史，伪史从垃圾变成观念史料；他把层累方法移植到民间故事（孟姜女研究）与地理文献（《禹贡》考辨），一手推动了民俗学的学科化与历史地理学的发端；他组织的歌谣采集、禹贡学会、论战办刊与资料室孵化，示范了现代学术生产组织学的全套零件；晚年近七百万字日记与四万册藏书的身后捐赠，完成了个人学术向公共学术基础设施的转化
historical_significance_en: The lawgiver of the 'doubting-antiquity school' of modern Chinese historiography: the nine volumes of the Gushibian and the thesis of 'the ancient history of China cumulatively fabricated' drove two millennia of credulous tradition into the position of having to defend itself — Hu Shih called it 'a great contribution to the historiography of our day', and Fu Sinian, though he disagreed, owned its power to shake; Gu upgraded criticism from 'reject the false, keep the true' to 'establish no single truth; trace only the flow of change' — displacing the object of study from the truth of high antiquity to the evolution of ideas of it, forgeries turning from refuse into evidence of ideas; he carried the cumulative method into folk tale (the Meng Jiangnü study) and geographic texts (the Tribute of Yu), midwifing the discipline of folklore and the birth of historical geography; his ballad-gathering network, the Yu Gong Society, the journal-as-arena and the incubating archive displayed the whole set of parts of a modern organisation of scholarship; the diary of nearly seven million characters and the bequest of forty thousand volumes completed the conversion of a private scholarship into public infrastructure
unique_thinking: 顾颉刚的思维内核是'给整座大厦做地层学'：他不满足于判定单条史料的真伪，而要回答'这个传说是谁、在哪个时代、为了什么需要而加上去的'——把辨伪从点升级为系统的演化史；第二个内核是'对象置换'：不立一真、惟穷流变——伪书被证伪得越彻底，作为其时代思想的证据越纯，破与立在方法上合一；第三个内核是'证据平权'：歌谣与经传同等有效，民间口头传统是民众自己写的历史——史料民主化；第四个内核是把学术生涯本身工程化：日记、进度账、精力账、人脉账四本账并行，研究生命可审计；第五个内核是'破后必立'：拆掉旧古史后必须建禹贡学会重建地理框架、办《禹贡》培养学科传人——批判方法的最高形态是向相邻学科输出地基
unique_thinking_en: Gu Jiegang's cognitive core is stratigraphy for the whole edifice: never content to judge one record true or false, he asks who added this legend, in which age, to serve what need — criticism of single points upgraded to the evolutionary history of a system; the second core is the displacement of the object: establish no single truth, trace only the flow — the more thoroughly a forgery is exposed the purer its testimony to its own age, demolition and construction one in method; the third is the equal standing of evidence: ballad and classic alike valid, the oral tradition of the folk the history written by the people themselves — the democratisation of sources; the fourth, the engineering of the scholarly life itself: diary, progress account, energy account and relations ledger run in parallel, a research life made auditable; the fifth is 'after demolition, build': having taken down the old ancient history he founded the Yu Gong Society to rebuild the geographic frame and trained the discipline's heirs — the highest form of the critical method is to export foundations to its neighbouring disciplines
civilization_zh: 清末民初至共和国的学术转型社会：科举废除与新学术建制（大学/研究所/学会）的交替、北大新文化运动与整理国故运动的思想市场、书局报刊（商务印书馆/读书杂志/歌谣周刊）催生的现代学术出版体系、疑古与信古/今文与古文经学的百年争论场、民间口头传统与庙堂文献的价值重估、抗战流徙中学术机构的西迁与坚守、从个人书斋到学科建制的学术生产组织化进程
civilization_en: The academic transforming society from the late Qing through the Republic to the People's Republic: the examination's abolition and the rise of the new academic institutions (universities, institutes, societies), the intellectual marketplace of Peking University's New Culture and 'reorganising the national heritage' movements, the modern scholarly publishing system of publishing houses and periodicals (the Commercial Press, the Reading Magazine, the Ballad Weekly), the century-long arena of doubting versus crediting antiquity and of New-Text versus Old-Text learning, the revaluation of oral folk tradition against courtly documents, the westward flight of academic institutions through the war years, and the organisation of scholarly production from the private study to the built discipline
roles_zh: 史学家（古史辨派创始人、'层累说'提出者）；民俗学家（孟姜女研究、歌谣研究会核心）；历史地理学奠基人（禹贡学会创办者）；文献学家（《尚书》研究、《古今伪书考》整理）；学术组织者（论战办刊、资料室建设、学科传人培养）
roles_en: Historian (founder of the Gushibian school, author of the cumulative-fabrication thesis); folklorist (the Meng Jiangnü study, core of the Ballad Society); founder of historical geography (creator of the Yu Gong Society); philologist (studies of the Book of Documents, revision of the Examen of Old and New Books); organiser of scholarship (the journal as arena, the building of archives, the training of a discipline's heirs)

modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论/把古史系统当作逐层叠加的建构物来解剖——'时代愈后，传说的古史期愈长'，传说中心人物愈放愈大，辨伪的对象不是单条史料而是整座史的沉积岩
modes.domain_en: Historiographical methodology / treating the received ancient-history system as a formation built up layer upon layer — 'the later the age, the longer the legendary antiquity it knows', the legendary figures ever enlarged as they are retold — so the object of criticism is not the single item of evidence but the whole sedimentary rock of the constructed past
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/1923 年顾颉刚在《与钱玄同先生论古史书》中提出'层累地造成的中国古史'说：第一，'时代愈后，传说的古史期愈长'——周代人心目中最古的人是禹，到孔子时有尧舜，到战国时有黄帝神农，到秦有三皇，到汉以后有盘古；第二，'时代愈后，传说中的中心人物愈放愈大'——舜在孔子时只是'无为而治'的圣君，到《尧典》就成了一个'齐家治国'的圣人；第三，即使不能知道某一件事的真确状况，'但可以知道某一件事在传说中的最早的状况'——他不是要复原上古真相，而是要解剖古史观念本身的演化史；操作上这是把崔述《考信录》的辨伪传统与进化论结合：古书是逐层累积的档案，越早的文献里越晚出的上古帝王越不存在——层的顺序就是造伪的顺序；这个诊断在方法上等于宣布：研究古史的第一步不是相信或怀疑某条记载，而是给整座传说大厦做地层学——哪一层在哪个时代被加上去，为什么那个时代需要加上去；胡适称此说为'今日史学界的一大贡献'，钱玄同、傅斯年皆为之震动，由此引发持续数年的古史大论战
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology: in 1923, in his Letter to Mr. Qian Xuanton on Ancient History, Gu Jiegang advanced the thesis of 'the ancient history of China cumulatively fabricated': first, 'the later the age, the longer the legendary antiquity it knows' — for the Zhou the oldest figure was Yu; by Confucius's time, Yao and Shun; by the Warring States, the Yellow Emperor and Shennong; by the Qin, the Three Sovereigns; by the Han and after, Pangu; second, 'the later the age, the larger the central figure of the legend grows' — Shun, in Confucius's day a ruler who governed by non-action, becomes in the Canon of Yao a sage of 'regulating the family and ordering the state'; third, 'even when the true state of a matter cannot be known, one can know the earliest state of the matter as legend' — his aim was not to recover the truth of high antiquity but to dissect the evolution of the very ideas of ancient history; operationally the method weds Cui Shu's critical tradition of the Record of Credibility to evolutionary theory: the old books are an archive accumulated layer upon layer, and the later-received sage-kings are absent from the earlier texts — the order of the strata is the order of the fabrication; the diagnosis amounts to a declaration: the first step in studying ancient history is neither to believe nor to doubt a given record, but to do stratigraphy on the whole edifice of legend — which stratum was added in which age, and why that age needed it added; Hu Shih called it 'a great contribution to the historiography of our day', Qian Xuantong and Fu Sinian were shaken by it, and out of it grew the great debate on ancient history that ran for years
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚《与钱玄同先生论古史书》(1923，《努力周报·读书杂志》)；《答刘胡两先生书》
modes.key_quote_zh: 层累地造成的中国古史——时代愈后，传说的古史期愈长；研究古史的第一件事，是给传说大厦做地层学。
modes.key_quote_en: The ancient history of China was cumulatively fabricated — the later the age, the longer the legendary antiquity it knows; the first task of the student of ancient history is stratigraphy upon the edifice of legend.
key_concepts: 地层学眼光 stratigraphic eye（把古史系统看作沉积岩而非通史——先分层再谈真伪）
the stratigraphic eye (see the received system as sedimentary rock, not a narrative of the past — assign strata before judging truth)
层的顺序即造伪的顺序 the order of strata is the order of fabrication（越早的文献越晚的帝王越缺席——层累方向可实测）
the order of strata is the order of fabrication (the later sages are absent from the earlier texts — the direction of accretion is measurable)
传说的最早状况 the earliest state of the legend（不求真伪先求'最早说法'——把不可知的真相换成可考的传播史）
the earliest state of the legend (ask for the earliest attested form before truth or falsehood — trading the unknowable past for a traceable history of transmission)
process_zh: 先分层：把同一传说的各版本按文献年代排成地层序列——最早的版本是基岩，越晚越浅表
逐层归因：每一新层都问两个问题——哪个时代加的？那个时代为什么需要加？
方向判定：用层累方向核对传说演化方向（人物由小变大、谱系由短变长）——方向反常即警报
写成演化史：结论不写成'真相是什么'而写成'观念如何演变'——把考据升级为观念史
process_en: Stratify first: arrange the variants of one legend into a chronological sequence of strata — the earliest attested version is bedrock, later ones are shallower deposits
Attribute each layer: for every new stratum ask two questions — which age added it, and why did that age need it
Test the direction: check the evolution of the legend against the direction of accretion (figures growing, genealogies lengthening) — a reversal is an alarm
Write the evolution, not the truth: the conclusion is stated as 'how the idea evolved', not 'what really happened' — criticism upgraded to the history of ideas
representative_cases_zh: 禹的演进实测：从《诗经·商颂》《论语》里的禹（无尧舜上游）到《尧典》体系的完型——层累方向逐文献可验
《尧典》中舜的放大：孔子时'无为而治'的舜到《尧典》成为齐家治国的完人——中心人物愈放愈大的标本
古史辨论战 (1923-1941)：刘掞藜、胡堇人以'信古'立场围攻，顾颉刚以层累说逐条应战——方法在论战中被反复打磨并公之于学界
representative_cases_en: Yu's measured evolution: from the Yu of the Odes and the Analects (with no Yao-and-Shun upstream) to the completed canon of the Canon of Yao — the direction of accretion verifiable text by text
The enlargement of Shun in the Canon of Yao: from the non-acting ruler of the Analects to the perfect sage of family and state — the specimen of the ever-growing central figure
The Gushibian debate (1923-1941): attacked by Liu Ku-e-li and Hu Jin-ren from the credulous standpoint, Gu answered point by point — the method hammered into shape in open combat and made public
modern_applications_zh: 产品演化分析：把用户对'公司起源''品牌故事'的各版本按时间排序——故事越讲越长的方向暴露了编造的顺序
组织史审计：把'我们一直这么做'的规章制度按文件年代分层——越晚的文件越爱把惯例说成'自古如此'
方法论论文写作：不写'X 是什么'而写'对 X 的认识如何逐层形成'——把结论升级为观念演化史
modern_applications_en: Product-evolution analysis: sort the versions of the 'company origin story' by date — the ever-lengthening tale exposes the order in which it was fabricated
Audit of organisational lore: stratify the 'we have always done it this way' rules by document date — the later the document, the fonder it is of calling a custom immemorial
Writing a methods paper: not 'what X is' but 'how understanding of X formed layer by layer' — conclusions upgraded to a history of ideas
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
崔述（思想源流：《考信录》'以经为纲'的辨伪谱系——层累说的直接前驱）
库尔根 (F. A. Wolf)（对照：'荷马问题'对史诗成层的解剖——西方古典学的同构方法）

modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论/对旧古史系统下总攻击的判别标准——打破民族出于一元、地域向来一统、古史为黄金世界、古史人化或神化的旧观念
modes.domain_en: Historiographical methodology / the criteria of a general assault on the received system of ancient history — breaking the assumptions that the nation had a single origin, that the realm was always unified, that antiquity was a golden age, and that the ancients were made men or made gods
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/1923 年《答刘胡两先生书》中，顾颉刚把层累说落成四条可操作的破坏判据：其一'打破民族出于一元的观念'——三代不同祖、夷夏本不同源，一元谱系是后来的合并工程；其二'打破地域向来一统的观念'——把各地传说还归各地（禹的传说属西方九鼎神话系统，不必强纳中原谱系）；其三'打破古史人化的观念'——神话人物被后世伦理化改写（'夔一足'从独脚兽改写成乐正），先问神形再问人形；其四'打破古代为黄金世界的观念'——上古物质与文明的贫乏是可推的常态，黄金时代叙事本身就是层累的产物；四个打破的价值在于把'疑古'从气质变成判据：任何人提出一条古史记载，都可以用这四把刀逐条检视——它是否预设了一元谱系？是否强并了地域传说？是否把神写成了人？是否把上古镀了金？这是从破坏走向建设的桥：只有先拆掉四个默认值，重建的古史才有地基
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology: in the Reply to Messrs. Liu and Hu (1923) Gu turned the cumulative thesis into four operational criteria of demolition: first, 'break the notion that the nation had a single origin' — the Three Dynasties had different ancestors, Yi and Xia different sources; the unified pedigree is a later work of merger; second, 'break the notion that the realm was always one' — restore each legend to its own region (the legend of Yu belongs to the nine-cauldron mythology of the west, not to be forced into the Central-Plains genealogy); third, 'break the humanising of ancient history' — mythic figures were rewritten by later ethics ('Kui, one-footed', a one-legged beast, rewritten as the music-master), so ask after the divine form before the human; fourth, 'break the golden-age view of antiquity' — the poverty of early material culture is the inferable norm, and the golden-age narrative is itself a product of accretion; the worth of the four breaks is to turn 'doubting antiquity' from a temperament into criteria: any received record can be examined blade by blade — does it presuppose a single pedigree? does it force regional legends together? does it write a god as a man? does it gild the archaic age? — the bridge from demolition to construction: only after the four defaults are torn down can a rebuilt ancient history have foundations
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚《答刘胡两先生书》(1923，《读书杂志》第 18 期)
modes.key_quote_zh: 四个打破：民族不出于一元，地域不向来一统，古史未经人化，古代并非黄金世界——疑古从气质变成判据。
modes.key_quote_en: Four breaks: the nation not of one origin, the realm not always one, the ancients not humanised, antiquity no golden age — doubt turned from temperament into criteria.
key_concepts: 判据化怀疑 criteria-bound doubt（疑古不是气质是四把刀——每条记载可逐条检视）
criteria-bound doubt (scepticism not a mood but four blades — every record examinable item by item)
地域还原 regional restoration（把传说还归各自的地望——一统叙事是合并工程的产物）
regional restoration (return each legend to its own locality — the unified narrative is the product of merger)
先神后人 divine form before human form（神话人物先问神形再问人形——伦理化改写是后层）
divine form before human form (ask after the mythic shape before the moralised one — the ethical rewrite is a later stratum)
process_zh: 列默认值：把一段古史叙事拆出它的隐含前提——一元？一统？人化？镀金？
逐条打破：每个默认值配一个反例检验——找该层被加上的文献证据
地域归位：把被合并的地方传说按地望拆回原位——画出'传说的地图'而非'一统的谱系'
留出地基：打破之后明确写出'拆掉的是什么、剩下的可重建的是什么'——破坏为建设开路
process_en: List the defaults: unpack an ancient-history narrative into its hidden premises — single origin? universal realm? humanised gods? gilded age?
Break item by item: test each default against a counter-instance — find the textual evidence of when that layer was added
Restore the regions: take the merged local legends apart by locality — draw the map of legends, not the unified pedigree
Mark the ground cleared: after demolition state explicitly what was removed and what remains buildable — destruction clears the way for construction
representative_cases_zh: 对'炎黄子孙'一元叙事的解剖：从战国秦汉的合并工程反推各族自有祖源——民族一元是政治需要的后层
禹属西方九鼎神话的地域还原：把禹从中原正统谱系拆回西羌地望——地域一统叙事松动的标本
'夔一足'的先神后人检验：从《国语》的独脚兽神到《尧典》的乐正夔——神话伦理化改写的层序可见
representative_cases_en: The anatomy of the 'descendants of Yan-Huang' single-origin narrative: back from the Warring States-Qin-Han merger to the separate ancestries of the several peoples — unity as a political later stratum
The regional restoration of Yu to the nine-cauldron mythology of the west: taking Yu out of the Central-Plains orthodox pedigree — the specimen of the unified-realm narrative loosening
The divine-before-human test of 'Kui, one-footed': from the one-legged beast of the Discourses to the music-master of the Canon of Yao — the stratal order of ethical rewriting made visible
modern_applications_zh: 组织合并审计：两家公司合并后的'共同创始故事'按时间分层——一元叙事是并购后的合并工程
产品叙事检验：对'经典由来'的营销叙事问四个打破——是否强并了各地版本、是否镀金
谈判与叙事拆解：对方'从来如此'的立场用四把刀逐条检视——先拆默认值再谈条件
modern_applications_en: Merger audit: stratify the 'shared founding story' of a merged company by date — the single-origin narrative is a post-merger fabrication
Product-narrative test: put the marketing tale of a 'classic recipe' to the four breaks — forced merger of regional versions? gilding?
Negotiation deconstruction: examine the other side's 'it has always been thus' blade by blade — clear the defaults before discussing terms
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
刘掞藜、胡堇人（论战对手：信古立场的代表——四个打破正是在应战中定型）
赫胥黎（思想源流：进化论对'黄金古代'的破除——《天演论》一代的共同思想装备）

modes.name_en: No Single Truth, Trace the Flow Method
modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论/考辨古史的旨趣重设——不追问上古真相而追问古史观念的演变，'解释古史的构成'，借伪史窥测其产生时代的思想
modes.domain_en: Historiographical methodology / resetting the aim of textual criticism — not to recover the truth of high antiquity but to trace the evolution of ideas of it, 'explaining how the ancient history was constructed', reading the forged past to sound out the thought of the age that forged it
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/顾颉刚最受误解也最深刻的一面：他反复澄清自己考辨古史的兴趣'不在古史而在古史学的演变'——'不立一真，惟穷流变'；批评者指责他'抹杀古史'，实际是他追求的'真'与信古者不同：信古者要传世文献里的上古真相，他要借'伪史'透视产生它的那个时代的真观念——战国秦汉人因应时势需要如何逐步构建旧有的古史系统；这等于给史学方法做了一次'对象置换'：研究客体从'过去发生的事'换成'过去的人如何想象过去发生的事'——伪史从垃圾变成第一手史料，只是史料的价值指向它的产生层而非它叙述的层；操作上这是传播学与观念史的双栖方法：任何文本都同时是两个时代的证词——它所叙述的时代与它被写作的时代，后者往往更可靠也更珍贵；这个置换让他立于不败：伪书被证伪得越彻底，作为其时代思想的证据反而越纯
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology: the most misunderstood and the deepest side of Gu's work — he repeatedly clarified that his interest in criticising ancient history lay 'not in the ancient history but in the evolution of the learning about it': 'establish no single truth; trace only the flow of change'; accused by critics of 'obliterating the ancient history', he in fact sought a different truth than the credulous: they wanted the truth of high antiquity within the received texts, he wanted to read the forged past as evidence of the genuine ideas of the age that forged it — how the men of the Warring States, Qin and Han, in answer to the needs of their moment, built up the received system step by step; this is a displacement of the object of study: from 'what happened in the past' to 'how people of the past imagined what happened' — forged books turn from refuse into first-class evidence, only their value points to the stratum of their making, not the stratum they narrate; the method is at home in both transmission studies and the history of ideas: every text is testimony of two ages — the age it narrates and the age in which it was written, and the latter is often the more reliable and the more precious; the displacement makes his position unassailable: the more thoroughly a forgery is exposed, the purer it becomes as evidence of its own age's thought
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚《古史辨》第四册自序；《战国秦汉间人的造伪与辨伪》
modes.key_quote_zh: 不立一真，惟穷流变——伪书被证伪得越彻底，作为其时代思想的证据反而越纯。
modes.key_quote_en: Establish no single truth; trace only the flow of change — the more thoroughly a forgery is exposed, the purer its testimony to its own age.
key_concepts: 对象置换 object displacement（研究客体从'发生的事'换成'对事的想象'——伪史变成观念史料）
object displacement (the object of study shifts from the happening to the imagining of it — forgeries become evidence of ideas)
双重证词 double testimony（每个文本同时证明叙述层与写作层——写作层常更可靠）
double testimony (every text witnesses to both its narrated and its written stratum — the written stratum often the sounder witness)
证伪即提纯 refutation as purification（证伪越彻底史料越纯——破与立在方法上合一）
refutation as purification (the fuller the exposure, the purer the evidence — demolition and construction one in method)
process_zh: 给文本定双坐标：拿到任何文本先标两个年代——它叙述的时代、它写作的时代
把重心移到写作层：问'作者为什么此刻需要这个故事'——时势需要即造伪动力
把伪史当史料用：证伪结论直接转写为该时代思想状况的判断——一物两用
在结论里声明旨趣：明确写出'本文不解决 X 真伪，只解决 X 观念的演变'——防误解先于防攻击
process_en: Give every text two coordinates: on receiving any text mark two dates — the age it narrates and the age that wrote it
Move the weight to the writing stratum: ask 'why did the author need this story at this moment' — the pressure of the moment is the engine of fabrication
Use the forgery as evidence: convert the exposure directly into a judgement on the thought of its age — one work, two uses
Declare the aim in the conclusion: state plainly 'this paper does not settle the truth of X but the evolution of the idea of X' — guard against misreading before guarding against attack
representative_cases_zh: 《战国秦汉间人的造伪与辨伪》：把造伪史写成造伪者的思想史——伪书清单直接变成战国秦汉观念地图
孟姜女故事研究：从《左传》'杞梁妻'到哭倒长城——不问孟姜女真假，专写故事如何被每个时代改写
对'疑古抹杀古史'指责的公开自辨：多次撰文澄清'我求的是伪史产生时代的真'——旨趣声明成为方法论的一部分
representative_cases_en: The Fabrication and Criticism of History between the Warring States, Qin and Han: the register of forgeries written as a history of the forgers' thought — the list of fakes becomes a map of the age's ideas
The Legend of Meng Jiangnü: from the wife of Qi Liang in the Zuo Commentary to the woman who wept down the Wall — never asking whether she existed, writing only how each age rewrote her
The public self-defence against 'doubting obliterates antiquity': essay after essay clarifying 'I seek the truth of the age that made the forgeries' — the declaration of aim made part of the method
modern_applications_zh: 用户研究：不问'用户说的需求是否真实'而问'用户为什么此刻需要这个说法'——诉求文本当观念证据用
竞品分析：对竞品宣传稿做双坐标定位——它叙述的市场与它写作时的市场焦虑
内部传闻治理：把谣言证伪的过程直接转写为'组织此刻在担心什么'的诊断——证伪即提纯
modern_applications_en: User research: not 'is what the user says true' but 'why does the user need to say it now' — the request read as evidence of the underlying idea
Competitive analysis: give a rival's press piece two coordinates — the market it narrates and the market anxiety at the time of writing
Governance of rumour: convert the debunking of a rumour directly into a diagnosis of 'what the organisation fears at this moment' — refutation as purification
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
兰克 (Leopold von Ranke)（对照：'如实直书'的真——同一史学职业里对象置换的两种方向）
维柯 (Giambattista Vico)（同道：'民族世界'由人制造故可由人认识——造伪史即造伪者心灵史）

modes.domain_zh: 文献学方法论/以'伪书中有真史料、真书中有伪史料'的全盘清理眼光重审传世文献——辨伪不为弃书而为给每一部书定可用边界
modes.domain_en: Philological methodology / a whole-archive re-audit of the received texts under the rule that 'forgeries hold genuine material, genuine books hold forged strata' — criticism not to discard books but to set for each its usable boundary
modes.definition_zh: 文献学方法论/《古史辨》九册的理论底座是辨伪学：顾颉刚继承姚际恒《古今伪书考》与崔述《考信录》的谱系而大幅升级——姚崔的目的是'黜伪存真'（把伪书扔掉），顾的目的改为'给书定级'（每部书在某时代某问题上可用到什么程度）；操作要点有三：其一'伪书中有真史料'——《列子》虽晚出却保存了战国思想碎片，伪书是伪时代写的真档案；其二'真书中有伪史料'——《尚书》里的《尧典》混入较晚层，真书内部还要再分层；其三'辨伪四标准'——逸文辑录有无来历、思想与时代合不合、制度与时代合不合、文体与时代合不合；这套方法把整个传世文献库变成一份'分级可用清单'：研究某时代思想只能用该层文献，研究更早时代必须先做降层处理；这是数据治理思维在文史领域的原型：入库先定级、引用先验层
modes.definition_en: Philological methodology: beneath the nine volumes of the Gushibian lies a doctrine of forgery-criticism: Gu inherited the line of Yao Jiheng's Examen of Old and New Books and Cui Shu's Record of Credibility but upgraded it wholesale — Yao and Cui aimed to 'reject the false and keep the true' (throw out the forged books); Gu's aim became 'grading every book': to what degree, in which age, on which question, is each text usable; three operating points: first, 'forgeries hold genuine material' — though late in date, the Liezi preserves shards of Warring States thought; a forged book is a genuine archive of its forged age; second, 'genuine books hold forged strata' — the Canon of Yao inside the Book of Documents is a later layer, and a true book must be stratified internally too; third, the four criteria of criticism — the provenance of gleaned fragments, the fit of thought to age, the fit of institutions to age, the fit of style to age; the method turns the whole received library into a graded usability register: to study an age's thought use only that stratum, and to study earlier ages first downgrade the strata; it is data-governance thinking in prototype: grade on intake, verify the stratum before citation
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚《古史辨》第一册自序；《尚书·尧典》研究系列；姚际恒《古今伪书考》整理
modes.key_quote_zh: 伪书中有真史料，真书中有伪史料——辨伪不是扔书，是给每一部书定可用边界。
modes.key_quote_en: Forgeries hold genuine material, genuine books hold forged strata — criticism discards no book; it sets each one's usable boundary.
key_concepts: 定级不废除 grading not banning（伪书是伪时代的真档案——每部书都有其可用层）
grading not banning (a forged book is a true archive of its forged age — every book has a stratum where it is evidence)
内部再分层 internal re-stratification（真书内部还要分层——《尧典》之于《尚书》）
internal re-stratification (even a true book stratifies internally — the Canon of Yao within the Documents)
四合检验 the four fits（思想/制度/文体/来历与所托时代合不合——不合即降层）
the four fits (thought, institutions, style, provenance against the claimed age — a mismatch demotes the stratum)
process_zh: 先查来历：某文献最早出现在哪部书、被谁引用——失载越早嫌疑越大
四合体检：把书的思想、制度、文体分别与其自称的年代对表——逐项打分
定级归档：按体检结果给每部书写'可用边界卡'——哪个时代的问题可引、哪些只能存疑
用前验层：任何引用前先核对目标问题的时代与文献层位——层位错配即停用
process_en: Check provenance first: where does a text first surface, who cites it — the later the first attestation, the deeper the suspicion
Run the four fits: set the book's thought, institutions and style against its claimed date and score item by item
Grade and file: write each book a usability card from the results — which ages' questions it may answer, which must hold it in doubt
Verify the stratum before citing: before any citation check the target question's age against the text's stratum — a mismatch halts the use
representative_cases_zh: 《尧典》分层：从《尚书》整体中拆出较晚的《尧典》层——'真书内伪层'的范式判例
对《古今伪书考》的整理与扩充：姚际恒的'黜伪'清单被顾改造成'定级'档案——方法升级的现场记录
《古史辨》各册按'问题-文献层'组织论战：每一册都是一次'哪些文献可讨论哪些问题'的边界重划
representative_cases_en: The stratification of the Canon of Yao: prised from the Book of Documents as a later layer — the paradigm case of the forged stratum inside a true book
The revision of the Examen of Old and New Books: Yao Jiheng's register of rejection rewritten as an archive of grading — the record of a method upgraded
The volumes of the Gushibian organised by question-and-stratum: each volume a redrawing of the boundary of which texts may discuss which questions
modern_applications_zh: 知识库治理：给每份资料建'可用边界卡'——什么场景可引用、什么场景须存疑
AI 语料清洗：训练数据先做'年代与主题匹配'体检——思想与制度错层的文本降级
引文规范：引用前核对'文献层位与论证年代'的匹配——层位错配即降权
modern_applications_en: Knowledge-base governance: give every source a usability card — citable for which questions, doubtful for which
AI corpus cleaning: run a date-topic fit check before training — texts whose thought and institutions misfit their claimed layer get demoted
Citation discipline: before citing, check the match of the source's stratum to the argument's period — a mismatch downgrades the claim
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
姚际恒（思想源流：《古今伪书考》——'黜伪存真'到'定级可用'的升级起点）
钱玄同（同盟：以文字音韵学供给辨伪的硬证据——'经古史上古文字皆后起'）

modes.domain_zh: 民俗学方法论/对一个故事的全部变体做时空双维排列——从最早的文献形态到各地的口头变体画出'故事的家谱'，以流变图代替真相追问
modes.domain_en: Folklore methodology / arranging all variants of a tale along two axes, time and place — drawing the 'genealogy of the story' from its earliest written form to its regional oral variants, a map of drift in place of the question of truth
modes.definition_zh: 民俗学方法论/1924 年顾颉刚发表《孟姜女故事的研究》，把层累说从古史移植到民间故事：孟姜女哭长城的故事，从《左传》杞梁妻（拒郊吊、无哭）到《檀弓》'其妻迎柩于路而哭之哀'，到刘向《说苑》《列女传》'哭于城下，十日而城为之崩'，再到唐以后的'哭长城''寻夫送寒衣'，到各地民歌宝卷的数百变体——他不做文学鉴赏也不问'孟姜女是否真有其人'，而是把每个变体按文献/采集时间与地域排成谱系网：故事在流传中被每个时代按自己的需要改写（礼制故事→哭城故事→反暴政故事），地域分布显示传播路径（山东→全国，与长城防线重合）；操作方法三要点：其一'变体即档案'——每个异文都是其时代地域的一面镜子；其二'谱系重建'——用共同母题与差异点重建版本树；其三'流变动因'——每一处改写对应一个时代地域的集体需要；这项研究让'民俗学'在中国从采风变成方法，钟敬文称其为'民俗学研究的典范'，歌谣研究会运动由此获得理论工具
modes.definition_en: Folklore methodology: in 1924 Gu published his Study of the Legend of Meng Jiangnü, transplanting the cumulative thesis from ancient history to folk tale: the story of Meng Jiangnü weeping down the Great Wall runs from the wife of Qi Liang in the Zuo Commentary (refusing a condolence visit, no weeping), through 'her wife met the bier on the road and wept sorrowfully' in the Tan Gong chapter, to 'she wept beneath the wall and in ten days the wall crumbled' in Liu Xiang, then to 'weeping down the Great Wall' and 'seeking the husband with winter clothes' after the Tang, and on to hundreds of variants in local songs and precious-scrolls; he offers no literary appreciation and never asks whether she existed, but arranges every variant into a genealogical net by date of record and by region: the story is rewritten by each age to its own need (ritual tale, wall-weeping tale, anti-tyranny tale), and the regional spread maps the route of transmission (Shandong outward, coinciding with the Great Wall lines); three operating points: 'the variant is the archive' — every version a mirror of its age and place; 'rebuild the genealogy' — reconstruct the version tree from shared motifs and points of difference; 'the motive of the drift' — each rewriting answers a collective need of its age and region; the study made folklore in China a method, not an antiquarian hobby — Zhong Jingwen called it 'the exemplar of folklore research', and the ballad-study movement gained its theoretical instrument
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚《孟姜女故事的研究》(1924，《歌谣周刊》69-96 号)；《孟姜女故事研究集》
modes.key_quote_zh: 每个变体都是其时代地域的镜子——不问故事真假，专画故事的家谱。
modes.key_quote_en: Every variant is a mirror of its age and place — never ask if the tale is true; draw its genealogy.
key_concepts: 变体即档案 variant as archive（每个异文是时代地域的证词——差异点即改写记录）
variant as archive (each version testifies to its age and region — the points of difference are the record of rewriting)
谱系重建 genealogy of the tale（用共同母题与差异点重建版本树——传播路径可视）
genealogy of the tale (reconstruct the version tree from shared motifs and differences — the route of spread made visible)
流变动因 motive of the drift（每处改写对应一个集体需要——故事是被需要塑造的活物）
motive of the drift (each rewriting answers a collective need — the tale a living thing shaped by demand)
process_zh: 穷举变体：把一个故事的所有文献与口头版本按'记录时间×地域'建卡片索引
找共同母题：拆出所有变体共享的最小叙事内核——内核即故事的原初形态候选
排版本树：按差异点把变体挂到谱系上——每条新枝标注'谁改的、何时何地改的'
解改写动因：对每个关键改写问'该时代该地域为什么需要这个改动'——故事史写成社会心态史
process_en: Enumerate the variants: index every written and oral version of the tale on cards keyed to date of record and region
Find the shared motif: extract the minimal narrative core all variants hold — the core is the candidate for the primal form
Hang the tree: place the variants on the genealogy by points of difference — each new branch annotated with who rewrote, when and where
Solve the motive: for each key rewriting ask what need of that age and region it served — the history of the tale written as a history of collective sentiment
representative_cases_zh: 孟姜女主线考：杞梁妻（礼制叙事）→哭城（汉代天人感应叙事）→哭长城（唐代徭役苦难叙事）→宝卷戏曲（反暴政叙事）——两千年的改写链完整可排
地域分布图：山东起源与长城沿线传播路线重合——故事地理学与军事地理学的对应
歌谣研究会《歌谣周刊》连载研究：学者与读者来信共同供料——'众包式'故事采集的早期实践
representative_cases_en: The main line of Meng Jiangnü: the wife of Qi Liang (ritual narrative), the weeping wall (Han omen-resonance narrative), the Great Wall (Tang corvée-suffering narrative), the scrolls and operas (anti-tyranny narrative) — a rewrite-chain of two millennia fully arrangeable
The regional map: the Shandong origin coinciding with the transmission route along the Wall — the geography of the tale matching the geography of garrison lines
The serialisation in the Ballad Weekly: scholars and readers supplying material by letter — an early practice of crowdsourced collection
modern_applications_zh: 品牌故事演化审计：把'创始人传说'的各版本按年份排列——每次改写对应融资/公关的哪个节点
用户共创内容研究：对同一梗的各平台变体做谱系重建——变体分布显示圈层传播路径
组织叙事治理：识别'公司历史'中被反复改写的桥段——每次改写背后是哪一届管理层需要
modern_applications_en: Audit of a brand legend: arrange every version of the founder myth by year — each rewriting keyed to a funding or PR event
Study of user-created content: rebuild the genealogy of one meme across platforms — the spread of variants maps the route through communities
Governance of organisational narrative: spot the episodes of 'company history' endlessly rewritten — and which management team needed each rewriting
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
钟敬文（同道与承者：'典范'评价与民俗学学科化的接棒人）
格林兄弟（对照：《儿童与家庭童话》的版本比较学——欧洲故事学的平行方法）

modes.domain_zh: 民俗学方法论/把民间歌谣谚语当作可系统采集分析的学术证据——用现代问卷与期刊网络取代古代采诗官，'由风俗中求历史'
modes.domain_en: Folklore methodology / treating folk songs and proverbs as evidence for systematic collection and analysis — replacing the ancient office of poem-gathering with the modern questionnaire and journal network, 'seeking history within custom'
modes.definition_zh: 民俗学方法论/顾颉刚是北大歌谣研究会的核心推动者：《歌谣周刊》发刊词宣称歌谣'是民俗学上的一种重要的资料'；他把《诗经》'采诗观风'的古典传统翻新成现代田野方法：其一'证据平权'——一首农夫的歌谣与一部经传在证明'民间的想法'上同等有效，甚至更有效（经传经过士大夫过滤，歌谣是直接证词）；其二'标准化采集'——设计采集表格（地域、演唱场合、曲调、方言注音），把采风从文人雅好变成可汇总的数据工程；其三'用歌谣证历史'——吴歌中的婚姻俗、谤语中的岁时观都是'民众心理的实录'；这一方法与他的孟姜女研究互为表里：采风供料，谱系法分析；更深一层是认识论宣言——历史的原料不只在庙堂文献里，也在田间地头的口头传统里，'民俗是民众自己写的历史'
modes.definition_en: Folklore methodology: Gu was the moving force of the Peking University Ballad Society, whose Weekly declared songs 'a body of first-rate material for folklore'; he renewed the classical 'gathering of poems to observe the customs' as modern field method: first, the equal standing of evidence — a farmer's ballad and a classic bear equally, even more, on 'what the folk thought', for the classics pass through literati filters while the ballad is direct testimony; second, standardised collection — forms designed for region, occasion of singing, tune and dialect transcription, turning gathering from gentlemanly taste into a data project that can be aggregated; third, history proven from songs — marriage customs in Wu songs, seasonal notions in proverbs, all 'verbatim records of the popular mind'; the method and the Meng Jiangnü study are two halves of one whole: gathering supplies, the genealogical method analyses; beneath lies an epistemological declaration — the raw material of history lives not only in courtly documents but in the oral tradition of the fields: 'folklore is history written by the people themselves'
modes.source_chapter: 《歌谣周刊》发刊词 (1922)；顾颉刚《吴歌甲集》及其序；北大歌谣研究会章程
modes.key_quote_zh: 歌谣是民俗学上重要的资料——历史的原料不只在庙堂文献里，也在田间地头的口头传统里。
modes.key_quote_en: Ballads are first-rate material for folklore — the raw material of history lives not only in courtly documents but in the oral tradition of the fields.
key_concepts: 证据平权 equal standing of evidence（未经士大夫过滤的口头证词在特定问题上优于经传）
equal standing of evidence (oral testimony unfiltered by literati outranks the classics on certain questions)
标准化采集 standardised collection（采集表格+方言注音+场合记录——采风变成可汇总的数据工程）
standardised collection (forms, dialect transcription, occasion records — gathering turned into an aggregable data project)
由俗证史 history from custom（婚姻俗、岁时观是民众心理实录——风俗是民众自己写的史）
history from custom (marriage customs and seasonal notions as verbatim records of the popular mind — folklore is the people's own history)
process_zh: 定采集对象与表格：先定义'采什么、记录哪些字段'——无表格的采集是游记不是数据
建采集网络：用期刊/学会/学校做分发与回收节点——单兵采风变成网络采风
平权入库：口头材料与文献材料同库同格式——给每条歌谣配地域/场合/采集人元数据
由俗证史：把汇总后的民俗数据当作特定问题的直接证词——写进论证时注明采集条件
process_en: Define the quarry and the form: first settle 'what to gather and which fields to record' — collection without a form is travel writing, not data
Build the network: use journals, societies and schools as distribution and return nodes — the lone collector becomes a network
File with equal standing: oral and written material in one archive, one format — every ballad carrying region, occasion, collector metadata
Argue from custom: use the aggregated folklore as direct testimony on defined questions — the collection conditions always stated
representative_cases_zh: 《吴歌甲集》：顾颉刚采集整理的苏州歌谣集——按'歌词+方言注音+按语'三件套出版，成为标准采集样例
《歌谣周刊》的读者来信采集网：全国教员学生按表格供稿——两年内积累数千首带元数据歌谣
妙峰山进香调查 (1925)：顾颉刚亲赴庙会做田野记录——香会组织与民众心理的现场证据
representative_cases_en: The Wu Songs, First Collection: Suzhou ballads gathered and edited by Gu, published with lyric, dialect transcription and commentary — the standard specimen of collection
The reader-letter network of the Ballad Weekly: teachers and students nationwide supplying by form — thousands of metadata-carrying songs within two years
The Miaofeng Mountain pilgrimage survey (1925): Gu's own fieldwork at the temple fair — on-site evidence of cult organisation and popular sentiment
modern_applications_zh: 用户之声工程：给客服/社群反馈建标准化采集表格——无结构的吐槽无法入库分析
众包数据采集：用社区/学校/行业网络做分发回收——单点调研变成网络调研
一手信源优先：在'二手转述'与'一线记录'间优先后者——未经过滤的证词价值更高
modern_applications_en: Voice-of-customer engineering: standard forms for support and community feedback — unstructured gripes cannot enter the archive
Crowdsourced collection: distribution and return through community, school and industry networks — the single-site survey becomes a network survey
First-hand sources first: prefer the unfiltered field record to the retelling — testimony closer to the source weighs more
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
刘半农（同盟：《歌谣周刊》的另一发动机——方言与音韵的采集技术担当）
周作人（同盟：发刊词的执笔与理论辩护——'民俗学资料'宣言的作者）

modes.domain_zh: 地理学方法论/把经典地理文献当作分层的行政与想象地图来解剖——《禹贡》是战国时期的'理想国规划书'而非大禹实录，地理考据为古史辨提供实体校验
modes.domain_en: Geographical methodology / dissecting classical geographic texts as stratified maps of administration and imagination — the Tribute of Yu a Warring States 'blueprint of an ideal realm', not a record of Yu; geographic criticism supplying physical verification to the criticism of ancient history
modes.definition_zh: 地理学方法论/1934 年顾颉刚创办禹贡学会与《禹贡》半月刊，把层累说延伸到地理文献：《禹贡》托名大禹而其九州五服制度恰是战国雄国的行政想象——'九州'不是大禹踏勘的记录，是战国士人按兼并版图设计的理想行政区划；考辨要点有二：其一'制度断代'——州制、甸侯绥要荒五服制与战国郡县化进程吻合，与禹代青铜时代的治理能力不合——地理制度本身就是断代证据；其二'水系校验'——把经文所述河流与实际水系对表，讹变与错简层可逐条定位；禹贡学会的历史意义在于把古史辨从'破'推向'立'：辨伪拆掉旧古史后，必须有人重建'可信的地理框架'——学会培养了谭其骧、侯仁之、史念海一代历史地理学家，中国历史地理学作为学科由此发端；谭其骧后来主持绘制的《中国历史地图集》即此脉络的果实；这是'辨伪学溢出效应'的典范：批判方法不只在原领域内消耗，而是向相邻学科输出地基
modes.definition_en: Geographical methodology: in 1934 Gu founded the Yu Gong Society and its fortnightly journal, extending the cumulative thesis to geographic texts: the Tribute of Yu, though ascribed to the great Yu, bears an administrative imagination of the Warring States great powers — its nine provinces and five services are not a record of Yu's survey but a scholar's blueprint of an ideal realm drawn on the map of conquest; two critical points: the dating of institutions — the provincial system and the five services match the Warring States march toward commanderies and counties, and exceed the governance capacity of a Bronze Age polity, so the geographic institutions themselves are dating evidence; and the check of waterways — the rivers named in the classic set against the actual hydrology, corruptions and displaced passages locatable item by item; the society's historical meaning is to push the criticism of ancient history from demolition to construction: once the old history is taken down, someone must rebuild a credible geographic frame — the society trained Tan Qixiang, Hou Renzhi and Shi Nianhai, and Chinese historical geography began as a discipline; the Atlas of Chinese Historical Maps that Tan later directed is the fruit of this line; a paradigm of the spillover of criticism: the critical method is not consumed within its home field but exports foundations to its neighbours
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚《禹贡》半月刊发刊词 (1934)；禹贡学会章程；《禹贡》研究论文系列
modes.key_quote_zh: 九州不是大禹踏勘的记录，是战国士人的理想行政区划——地理制度本身就是断代证据。
modes.key_quote_en: The nine provinces are no record of Yu's survey but a Warring States blueprint — the geographic institutions themselves are dating evidence.
key_concepts: 制度断代 dating by institutions（州制五服与战国郡县化吻合——治理制度的复杂度是年代硬指标）
dating by institutions (provinces and services matching the march to commanderies — institutional complexity a hard dating index)
水系校验 waterway verification（经文水系与实地对表——讹变逐条定位）
waterway verification (the classic's rivers set against the actual hydrology — corruptions located item by item)
破后立学 construction after demolition（辨伪拆旧史必有人重建地基——批判方法向相邻学科输出）
construction after demolition (when criticism takes down the old history someone must rebuild the frame — method exported to neighbour disciplines)
process_zh: 拆理想与实录：先判断一部地理文献是'踏勘记录'还是'规划想象'——看制度复杂度与时代能力是否匹配
用水系当尺子：把文献所述山川与实际地物逐条对表——错位处即分层线索
从破转立：辨伪结论整理成'可信框架'的重绘任务——拆完必须重画
建学科接力：把重建任务交给专门学会与后辈——个人考据升级为代际学科
process_en: Decide record or blueprint: first judge whether a geographic classic is a survey record or an imagined plan — does institutional complexity match the age's capacity?
Use the rivers as a ruler: set the named mountains and waters against the actual ground item by item — every misfit a clue to a stratum
From demolition to construction: convert critical findings into a task of redrawing the credible frame — having torn down, redraw
Pass to a discipline: hand the rebuilding to a dedicated society and younger scholars — private scholarship upgraded to an intergenerational discipline
representative_cases_zh: 《禹贡》九州制的战国断代：州界与战国兼并版图、郡县化进程吻合——'托古规划书'判例
禹贡学会的学科孵化：谭其骧/侯仁之/史念海皆出此门——《禹贡》半月刊成为历史地理学的产房
《中国历史地图集》的远源：谭其骧主持的地图工程是禹贡学会重建'可信地理框架'任务的最终完成
representative_cases_en: The Warring States dating of the nine-province system: provincial boundaries matching the map of conquest and the march to commanderies — the paradigm case of an 'ascribed antique blueprint'
The society as incubator: Tan Qixiang, Hou Renzhi and Shi Nianhai all came from the Yu Gong Society — the fortnightly the delivery room of historical geography
The far source of the Atlas of Historical Maps: Tan's cartographic project the final completion of the society's task of redrawing the credible frame
modern_applications_zh: 组织架构考古：对'从创立就有的流程'做制度复杂度审计——过于精致的制度常是后来追认的蓝图
规划文件断代：用'制度与当期执行能力的匹配度'给规划文档定年代——超前过度的规划是愿望不是记录
批判后重建：拆掉伪叙事后必须产出替代框架——只破不立的方法会失去组织信任
modern_applications_en: Organisational archaeology: audit 'processes since founding' for institutional complexity — an over-elaborate system is usually a retrospective blueprint
Dating planning documents: assign a date by how well the design matches the execution capacity of its claimed era — an over-ambitious plan is a wish, not a record
Rebuild after critique: after demolishing a false narrative produce a replacement frame — a method that only breaks loses organisational trust
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
谭其骧（承者：禹贡学会弟子——历史地理学学科化的完成者）
史念海（承者：禹贡学会弟子——沿革地理向历史地理转型的执行人）

modes.domain_zh: 学术生产方法论/把学术期刊办成公开论战的擂台与共同体建设器——用连载通信论战组织一个学派，用批评信件当稿件
modes.domain_en: Methodology of scholarly production / running a scholarly journal as an open arena of debate and a maker of community — organising a school through serialised epistolary combat, with critical letters as copy
modes.definition_zh: 学术生产方法论/古史辨学派的组织方式本身就是方法论创新：其一'通信即论文'——《与钱玄同先生论古史书》《答刘胡两先生书》都是书信体论战文，公开通信把私人讨论变成共同体公共事件，人人可以插手；其二'以刊聚人'——《古史辨》九册不单是文集，是论战的档案馆：把支持与反对的论文按问题编在一起，'对立面文章同刊发表'让论战全程可回溯；其三'以战选才'——论战中表现出的功力自动完成学派筛选，顾门弟子（童书业、杨向奎、赵贞信等）多由通信论战招募；其四'预印本文化'——重要论断先在《读书杂志》《歌谣周刊》连载接受炮火，成熟后结集——快速迭代+公开评审；这套组织术让古史辨成为'有组织怀疑'的中国样本：学派不是靠师承独断维持，是靠公开论战的市场纪律维持
modes.definition_en: Methodology of scholarly production: the way the Gushibian school was organised is itself methodological innovation: letters as papers — the Letter to Mr. Qian Xuanton and the Reply to Messrs. Liu and Hu are epistolary combats, and the publication of private correspondence turned a private exchange into a public event of the community, where anyone might join; the journal as magnet — the nine volumes of the Gushibian are not a miscellany but the archive of the debate: essays for and against bound together by question, the whole controversy traceable because opponents are printed side by side; selection through combat — members were recruited through the visible quality of their letters (Tong Shuye, Yang Xiangkui, Zhao Zhenxin and others came in this way); a preprint culture — major claims serialised first in the Reading Magazine or Ballad Weekly to take their fire, collected once matured: fast iteration plus open review; this craft made the Gushibian school a Chinese specimen of 'organised scepticism': the school held not by doctrinal lineage but by the market discipline of open debate
modes.source_chapter: 《古史辨》九册编排体例；《读书杂志》《歌谣周刊》连载论战 (1923-1941)；顾颉刚日记与书信中的办刊记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 对立面文章同刊发表，论战全程可回溯——学派不靠师承独断维持，靠公开论战的市场纪律维持。
modes.key_quote_en: Opponents printed side by side, the whole debate traceable — a school held not by doctrinal authority but by the market discipline of open combat.
key_concepts: 通信即论文 letters as papers（公开通信把私人讨论变成公共事件——人人可插手）
letters as papers (published correspondence turns private exchange into public event — anyone may join)
对立同刊 opponents side by side（批评文章与应战文章同录——论战档案保证可回溯性）
opponents side by side (attack and reply bound together — the debate kept auditable)
以战选才 selection through combat（功力在公开论战中可见——学派成员由论战自动筛出）
selection through combat (capacity visible in open debate — members filtered by the combat itself)
process_zh: 把讨论公开化：重要论断先以通信/预印本形式发出——接受炮火早于追求完美
对立面必须同录：编辑规则写死'批评文章与应战文章同刊'——不可只留赞歌
按问题建档：论战材料按争议问题归档而非按作者——后来者可整段回看
在论战中招募：把有功力的批评者变成合作者——敌人的高质量证明共同体的含金量
process_en: Float claims early: issue major theses first as letters or preprints — take the fire before seeking polish
Bind the opposition: an editorial rule that criticism and reply appear together — no leaving only hymns
File by question: archive the debate by contested issue, not by author — later comers can review whole rounds
Recruit from the combat: turn able critics into collaborators — the quality of the opposition proves the worth of the community
representative_cases_zh: 《与钱玄同先生论古史书》的发表：私人通信变成公共论战起点——'层累说'在炮火中三个月内成型迭代
《古史辨》九册的对立同录体例：刘掞藜的反对文与顾的应战文同册并置——中国史学史上罕见的全息论战档案
童书业的招募：一个商店学徒的论战来信被顾颉刚看中并招至门下——以战选才的著名案例
representative_cases_en: The publication of the Letter to Mr. Qian Xuanton: private correspondence become the starting shot of a public debate — the cumulative thesis iterated within months under fire
The bound opposition of the nine Gushibian volumes: Liu Ku-e-li's attacks and Gu's replies side by side — a rare holographic debate archive in Chinese historiography
The recruitment of Tong Shuye: a shop apprentice's combative letters caught Gu's eye and brought him into the school — the famous case of selection through combat
modern_applications_zh: 技术方案评审：把反对意见与方案正文同档归档——评审全程可回溯
开源社区治理：RFC/issue 论战公开进行，优质批评者转为维护者——以战选才
内部辩论文化：重大决策'先公开通信后定稿'——快速迭代加公开评审
modern_applications_en: Design review: file objections in the same dossier as the proposal — the whole review traceable
Open-source governance: run RFC and issue debates in the open, and turn able critics into maintainers — selection through combat
Culture of internal debate: major decisions floated as open memos before finalisation — fast iteration plus open review
representative_figures: 顾颉刚（核心）
钱玄同（同盟：论战第一对手兼第一盟友——通信论战体的开创性参与者）
胡适（同盟与后期批评者：'大胆假设小心求证'与古史辨的互相成就与分歧）

modes.domain_zh: 学术生产方法论/用连续数十年的日记与记账把'研究人生'本身变成可控工程——时间、金钱、著述进度全部入账，学术生涯可审计
modes.domain_en: Methodology of scholarly production / keeping diaries and accounts for decades so that the research life itself becomes a governable project — time, money and writing progress all entered on ledger, a scholarly career made auditable
modes.definition_zh: 学术生产方法论/顾颉刚的日记从 1913 年到 1980 年除战乱散佚外基本连续，配合他特有的'记账癖'：日记里记录每日读书/通信/论文进度，另有单独的收支账簿——他从青年时代就把自己的学术活动当成需要财务与进度管理的工程；操作要点有三：其一'进度可见'——每部大书（如《尚书》研究）都有跨越数十年的连续进度条，晚年可以精确说出某计划已推进到哪一步；其二'精力预算'——他自知'贪多骛广'的毛病，用日记做自我审计，反复写下'愿此后专力一处'的自我告诫；其三'人脉账'——与数百学者通信的记录按人归档，谁帮过什么忙、欠谁什么稿，一一入账——这使他能同时推进数十个合作项目而不崩盘；日记与账本合起来构成一个'研究生命的操作系统'：全息记录+定期复盘+预算约束
modes.definition_en: Methodology of scholarly production: Gu's diary runs near-continuously from 1913 to 1980 (war losses aside), joined to his peculiar habit of accounts: the diary records daily reading, correspondence and writing progress, with separate books of income and outlay — from youth he ran his scholarly life as a project needing financial and schedule management; three operating points: visible progress — every great work (such as the studies of the Book of Documents) has a progress bar running across decades, so that in old age he could state precisely how far each plan had come; the budget of energy — knowing his flaw of 'greed for breadth', he used the diary as self-audit, writing again and again 'may I hereafter devote myself to one thing'; the ledger of relations — correspondence with hundreds of scholars filed by person, who helped with what, what manuscript was owed whom, all entered — which let him advance dozens of collaborations at once without collapse; diary and ledger together form an operating system for a research life: full recording, periodic review, budget constraint
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚日记 (1913-1980)；顾颉刚书信集；晚年《自述》中的自我审计段落
modes.key_quote_zh: 把学术活动当成需要财务与进度管理的工程——数十年计划要有连续的进度条。
modes.key_quote_en: Run the scholarly life as a project with financial and schedule management — a decades-long plan needs a continuous progress bar.
key_concepts: 进度可见 visible progress（大书跨数十年要有连续进度条——晚年能说出每项计划推到哪步）
visible progress (a decades-spanning work needs a continuous progress bar — in old age one can state each plan's exact stage)
精力预算 the energy budget（自知贪多用日记自我审计——把广度冲动写进约束条款）
the energy budget (knowing one's greed for breadth, audit by diary — the impulse to sprawl written into constraint clauses)
人脉账 the ledger of relations（通信按人归档、恩稿债入账——数十合作并行不崩盘）
the ledger of relations (correspondence filed by person, favours and owed manuscripts entered — dozens of collaborations without collapse)
process_zh: 全息记录：每日的阅读/写作/通信流水入日记——不靠记忆靠流水账
项目分账：每部大书单独设进度账——记录'本月推进到哪一节'
定期自我审计：每月/每年复盘一次'精力投向与产出比'——把贪多冲动写成明文警告
人脉入账：合作者的求助与承诺逐条记录——信用是靠记账维持的
process_en: Full recording: daily reading, writing and correspondence entered as running entries — trust the ledger, not the memory
An account per project: every great work keeps its own progress book — 'this month advanced to which section'
Periodic self-audit: review monthly or yearly the ratio of energy spent to output — write the sprawl-impulse into explicit warnings
Relations on ledger: every request and promise to collaborators recorded — credit is maintained by bookkeeping
representative_cases_zh: 《尚书》研究六十年的连续进度：从青年立志到晚年尚在推进——单项目跨甲子的进度条世界罕见
日记中的自我告诫：'愿此后专力一处'反复出现——贪多毛病被明文管理数十年
数百通信者的档案系统：与钱玄同/胡适/傅斯年等的学术交往逐条可查——合作网络的可审计样本
representative_cases_en: Six decades of continuous progress on the Book of Documents: vowed in youth, still advancing in old age — a progress bar across sixty years, a rarity in the world
The self-admonitions in the diary: 'may I hereafter devote myself to one thing' recurring for decades — the flaw of breadth under written management
The filing system for hundreds of correspondents: every scholarly exchange with Qian, Hu or Fu traceable — an auditable sample of a collaboration network
modern_applications_zh: 个人知识管理系统：日记+项目分账+人脉账三件套——研究/创作生涯可审计
长期项目进度条：给十年级项目设独立进度账——按月记录推进节
精力预算复盘：定期审计'承诺数量与完成率'——把广度冲动写成明文约束
modern_applications_en: A personal knowledge system: diary plus per-project ledgers plus a relations ledger — a research or creative life made auditable
Progress bars for decade-scale projects: an independent progress book per long project, sections advanced logged monthly
Budget reviews of energy: audit commitments against completion on a cycle — the sprawl-impulse written into explicit constraint

modes.domain_zh: 学术生产方法论/把个人藏书与资料整理做成'公共基础设施'——资料室不只服务自己，而是持续孵化学科、学会与后辈的平台
modes.domain_en: Methodology of scholarly production / building one's private library and source-material work into public infrastructure — the archive serving not the self alone but as a platform that keeps hatching disciplines, societies and younger scholars
modes.definition_zh: 学术生产方法论/顾颉刚一生把'收书、编书、让书'当作研究工程的一半：其一'为学先积料'——他从青年起系统购置古籍与地方志，藏书四万余册并按研究问题分类编目，研究计划与资料积累同步设计；其二'资料共享'——禹贡学会的地图与方志收藏向全体会员开放，康有为《孔子托古改制考》手稿等珍本公之于众；其三'以料育人'——他把未整理的资料包分给年轻学者（如把《尚书》某专题的资料包交弟子整理发表），资料包成为学术训练与成果分配的双重装置；其四'身后开放'——晚年把藏书与手稿捐赠 institutions（藏入中国社会科学院等），个人资料室完成向公共财产的转化；这是'个人学术品牌'与'学科公共品'的合一：资料室是他的研究引擎，也是学派的孵化器，更是学科的蓄水池——三层结构逐级外溢
modes.definition_en: Methodology of scholarly production: all his life Gu made collecting, editing and giving away books half of his research engineering: first, 'accumulate materials before study' — from youth he systematically bought old books and gazetteers, over forty thousand volumes catalogued by research question, the plan of study and the accumulation of material designed together; second, 'materials shared' — the Yu Gong Society's maps and gazetteers open to all members, rare items like Kang Youwei's manuscript studies made public; third, 'raising people with material' — he handed unworked packages of sources to younger scholars (a dossier on a topic of the Book of Documents committed to a student to edit and publish), the dossier serving at once as apprenticeship and as allocation of results; fourth, 'open after death' — his library and manuscripts donated at the end of his life (to the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and others), the private archive transformed into public property; this is the union of a personal scholarly brand and a disciplinary public good: the archive is his research engine, the hatchery of his school, and the reservoir of the discipline — a three-tier structure spilling outward stage by stage
modes.source_chapter: 顾颉刚藏书与捐赠记录；《禹贡》学会资产章程；顾颉刚《自述》中的购书编目记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 为学先积料，料成公共品——个人资料室同时是研究引擎、学派孵化器、学科蓄水池。
modes.key_quote_en: Accumulate materials before study, and make them public goods — the private archive at once research engine, school hatchery, discipline reservoir.
key_concepts: 为学先积料 materials before study（藏书按研究问题分类编目——研究计划与资料积累同步设计）
materials before study (the library catalogued by research question — the plan of study and the accumulation designed together)
以料育人 raising people with material（未整理资料包交给后辈——资料包是训练与成果分配的双重装置）
raising people with material (unworked dossiers handed to juniors — the package both apprenticeship and allocation of results)
身后开放 open after death（私人资料室转化为公共财产——个人品牌升格为学科公共品）
open after death (the private archive transformed into public property — a personal brand upgraded to a disciplinary public good)
process_zh: 按问题收料：购置与采集按研究问题建分类——资料室是问题驱动的不是猎奇驱动的
共享出价值：珍本与工具向共同体开放——资料的引用网络就是影响力网络
用资料包带人：把'未整理资料+整理规范+署名'打包给后辈——培养与成果分配一次完成
规划身后：把资料室的最终归属写进计划——个人工程要有学科级遗产设计
process_en: Collect by question: purchases and gathers catalogued by research problem — the archive problem-driven, not curiosity-driven
Share to create value: rare items and tools open to the community — the citation network of one's material is the network of one's influence
Raise people with dossiers: hand juniors 'unworked material plus editorial rules plus attribution' — training and allocation done in one act
Plan the aftermath: write the archive's final destination into the plan — a personal project needs a discipline-scale legacy design
representative_cases_zh: 四万册藏书的编目体系：古籍与方志按研究问题分类——'为学先积料'的实体成果
禹贡学会的开放资料室：地图与方志向会员开放——学科共同体的物质基础
身后捐赠：藏书手稿入藏研究机构——个人资料室完成向公共学术基础设施的转化
representative_cases_en: A catalogue of forty thousand volumes: old books and gazetteers classed by research question — the physical yield of 'materials before study'
The open archive of the Yu Gong Society: maps and gazetteers for all members — the material base of a disciplinary community
The posthumous donation: library and manuscripts into research institutions — the private archive become public scholarly infrastructure
modern_applications_zh: 团队知识库治理：按业务问题（而非来源）组织资料——知识库是问题驱动的
用'资料包+规范+署名'培养新人：把可完成的子任务连人带料打包——培养与成果分配一次完成
开源化规划：给个人积累的项目/数据/文档规划开源路线——个人资产升格为生态公共品
modern_applications_en: Governance of a team knowledge base: organise material by business question, not by provenance — the archive problem-driven
Raising juniors with packages: bundle a completable subtask with its material, rules and attribution — training and allocation in one act
Planning the open-sourcing: map a route to open-source one's accumulated projects, data and documents — personal assets upgraded to ecosystem public goods
